anchors.summary: PR 500 closes without merge after a maintainer punts global scope-level body caching pending a complete streaming contract.
anchors.limitations: GitHub reports merged_at null. Its requests.py change and repeated-Request test remained in the unmerged PR; merge_commit_sha is not evidence that either artifact entered Starlette.

anchors.summary: PR 1692 merges a _CachedRequest wrapper for BaseHTTPMiddleware.call_next and changes Request.stream consumption tracking.
anchors.limitations: The patch replays a body cached by middleware-before-call_next, or sends an empty body after the middleware consumed the stream. It is not general replay for endpoint-first or exception-handler rereads.

anchors.summary: The final head contains regression coverage in tests/middleware/test_base.py and tests/test_requests.py, including downstream receive modification, disconnects, middleware/endpoint read orders, and multi-chunk Request streams.
anchors.limitations: The tests support the narrow merged behavior. They do not turn explicitly unsupported endpoint-first or exception-handler rereads into accepted behavior.

anchors.summary: Issue 495 closes immediately after PR 1692 merges.
anchors.limitations: Tracker closure records acceptance of the linked middleware-first target. It does not prove every request-body ownership order or every workaround is supported.
